def solve_n4():
    players = [1, 2, 3, 4]
    matches = [
        (1, 2), (1, 3), (1, 4),
        (2, 3), (2, 4), (3, 4)
    ]

    best_schedule = None
    
    # Iterate over all 6! = 720 schedules
    for schedule in permutations(matches):
        played_days = {p: set() for p in players}
        
        # 1. Record the days for each player
        for day, match in enumerate(schedule, 1):
            p1, p2 = match
            played_days[p1].add(day)
            played_days[p2].add(day)
            
        # 2. Calculate the cost for this schedule
        current_cost = 0
        for p in players:
            days = played_days[p]
            d_min = min(days)
            d_max = max(days)
            cost_p = d_max - d_min + 1
            current_cost += cost_p
            
        # 3. Update minimum cost
        if current_cost < min_cost:
            min_cost = current_cost
            best_schedule = list(schedule)
            
    return min_cost, best_schedule
